limitations: This is the historical AlekseiMarchenko v3 harness, not the current Vectorize AMB RAG/judge harness.
The upstream runner performs binary keyword scoring and is not an LLM QA benchmark.
The published package's CLI version string disagrees with its package version.
The multi-agent category is skipped, so the 75/100 score is not a full eight-category execution.
This baseline used the local product-core StatePlane through a frozen generic adapter; it is not a leaderboard claim.
disallowed_claims: Do not call 75/100 or 40/100 #1, SOTA, or an official current leaderboard result.
Do not compare this score to the historical calibrated 94/100 or 100/100 artifacts as if the protocols matched.
Do not attribute any future improvement to the adapter or to benchmark-specific keyword behavior.
